source_message: User asked to complete the persistent memory mechanism so network interruptions do not force repeated work.
goal: Make work recoverable after connection/session interruption without repeating already verified steps; connect source ingestion, approved semantic-memory processing, index refresh, and next-session restore, while preserving provenance and project boundaries.
confirmed_completed: Resumable source-ingestion runner exists and has CI tests for dry-run, apply/replay, uncertain registry acknowledgement after crash, tampered ledger, and missing state projection reconstruction.
Archive staging to sanitized intake to metadata-only source registry is implemented.
Concurrent intake publication race was reproduced, fixed, and covered by a two-process regression test.
Strict write-contract audit is enabled in CI.
The runner explicitly stops at SOURCE_REGISTERED_DOWNSTREAM_PENDING and does not claim semantic promotion, canonical index refresh, or automatic next-session restore.

Added tools/continuity_checkpoint_bundle.py: immutable paired TASK_STATE/HANDOFF generation, hash-linked parent generations, atomic CURRENT_CHECKPOINT pointer as the commit point, OS-managed lock, drift verification, and replay recovery after interruption.

Added six behavioral tests covering capture/verify, interruption after pointer publication, paired projection recovery, idempotent replay, parent-chain preservation, tamper rejection, and missing-pointer fail-closed behavior (five named test methods plus idempotent replay; total six tests).
Added strict write-contract classification for the checkpoint bundle and documented capture/verify/recover usage in core/agent_runtime_protocol.md.
Exact-head CI for 30be5e944d6dd2d8a60395626b52ef07ff898640 passed: 201 tests, one skipped; 85 mutation sites, zero unclassified.

confirmed_open.description: Inspect existing lifecycle/approval contracts. No canonical semantic-promotion executor was found in inspected tools. Specify and test an executor before implementing; never treat metadata-only source registration as accepted memory.
No verified canonical memory-index refresh executor is connected to the ingestion runner. archive_temporal_index.py is a read-only archive search/index, not a canonical memory index rebuild.
Restore reads project TASK_STATE.md, HANDOFF.md and events.jsonl; source registration does not automatically update or restore these records.

TASK_STATE.md and HANDOFF.md are not protected by a single paired-write protocol. Their history contains stale checkpoints; the latest verified repository state must be compared with checkpoint metadata before resuming.

A report that was never durably written to the repository cannot be reconstructed verbatim after a network interruption. Future work must persist concise checkpoints after each material verified milestone and distinguish persisted records from undelivered response text.

next_action: Append a new authoritative continuation checkpoint to TASK_STATE.md and HANDOFF.md and record the implementation event; then inspect memory-record schemas and lifecycle/approval gates to specify semantic promotion, canonical index refresh, and next-session restore contracts. Do not mark end-to-end memory processing complete until these stages are implemented and tested.
constraints: Do not merge PR #27 or modify main without explicit user approval.
Do not delete or rewrite source-history exports without a separate explicit decision.
Keep project histories isolated; unknown project applicability remains unknown.
Preserve chronology, failed attempts, uncertainty, and source provenance.
No semantic record is accepted merely because source metadata was registered.
Never report CI success for a SHA other than the exact checked SHA.
checkpoint_semantics: This is a durable task checkpoint committed to the integration branch. It is not an automatic ChatGPT autosave or proof that an undelivered response was saved.
